name: MCTS 2048
description: Evaluate whether an agent can select strong 2048 moves by following a Monte Carlo tree search policy under non-binary streak rewards.

binding_vow.description: Each episode is a short deterministic 2048 game. At every turn the environment exposes the board, valid moves, and a compact Monte Carlo tree search policy table computed with numpy and pandas. The agent must return one of up, down, left, or right. Rank-1 MCTS moves earn positive rewards that increase with a correct streak; legal lower-ranked moves and invalid moves receive increasingly negative penalties, creating a non-binary reward signal over the whole game.

observation_space.description: { "game": "2048", "seed": number, "step": number, "max_steps": number, "score": number, "max_tile": number, "empty_cells": number, "board": number[4][4], "valid_moves": string[], "mcts_policy": [{ "move": string, "rank": number, "visits": number, "mean_value": number, "immediate_score": number, "empty_after": number }], "instructions": string }

action_space.description: A single 2048 move: up, down, left, or right. JSON actions with a "move" or "action" field are also accepted.

reward.description: Non-binary shaped reward. Matching the rank-1 MCTS move starts at +1.0 and increases up to +2.0 with a correct streak. Legal but lower-ranked moves receive rank- and streak-scaled negative rewards. Invalid moves receive larger escalating penalties.
